data.name: Khawli
data.gender_notes: Khawli is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Khawlah’ meaning ‘to be strong or compelling’. In Islamic history, ‘Khawlah bint Al-Azwar’ was a courageous woman who protected the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during the Battle of Uhud. The name Khawli carries the meaning “Strong, Compelling” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khawli usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, compelling and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Khawli belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Compelling.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khawli total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
